programme.title: JD
programme.desc: Media brings news every moment from all over the world, but what happens within the media is not known to the world. JD focuses on this particular aspect of the media. JD unwinds the story of Jai Dwivedi alias JD. He had started his journalism from Lucknow but Delhi has always been his dream. JD breaks the news from inside the media. His pen has the power to shake the seats of power. JD tells the struggles of journalists who fight for the truth and values, but are helpless in fighting for their own rights. Every powerful Establishment first scares, then allures and finally crushes the journalists in a maze of defamatory conspiracies. Thus, the one who rises with a steely resolve from this fall becomes JD. However, the question remains whether JD will confront the powers of media and politics, or he will shake hands with them like many others.
